title: USpy
body:
# Useful Spyglasses!
## Description
Useful Spyglasses, or USpy, adds two new spyglass variants to Minecraft. The Glowglass, and the Invisiglass.

- ### The Glowglass
  The glowglass lets players see in the darkness just by looking through it. It's crafted using 2 copper ingots and one piece of glowstone dust.

- ### The Invisiglass
  The glowglass lets players see invisible entities just by looking through it. It's crafted using 2 copper ingots and one eye of ender.


  
## Other notes
All invisible players are able to see eachother and other invisible entities.

The datapack adds three new advancements for players to get.
